scope: verified ANSWER claims without explicit routing metadata in claims-v0.3
safety_fixes: Manager concurrent-role routing excludes 勤務表 so schedule-clarity queries do not resolve to the manager claim.
Care-plan delivery routing excludes 電子/電磁 so electronic-method queries do not resolve to the simple delivery claim.
Multi-room routing requires an explicit multiple-room signal; generic 合計面積 alone no longer resolves to the multi-room claim.
conclusion: All current ANSWER claims now have explicit routing metadata, but the existing verified regression still contains 17/51 ANSWER paths that rely on Issue-level fallback. The next task is to identify which queries need broader safe Claim routing versus which tests are too coarse to demand exact Claim resolution.
